headlines.title: Pimly Recognized in Salesforce 2027 Partner of the Year Awards for Transform & Scale
headlines.summary: Pimly Recognized for Its Co-Sell Work with Salesforce, Including a 5x Lift in Cross-Sell Performance for Customer GE Vernova Pimly Named a 2027 Salesforce Partner of the Year for Transform & Scale Pimly has been recognized in the 2027 Salesforce Partner of the Year Awards in the Transform & Scale category for helping GE Vernova unify more than 200,000 SKUs into one governed, Salesforce-native product catalog and layer Agentforce on top, driving a 5x improvement in cross-sell performance.

headlines.title: Jim Cramer Weighs In on GE Vernova (GEV) and NuScale Power (SMR)

(NYSE:GEV) with early-stage nuclear developer NuScale Power Corporation (NYSE:SMR). A caller mentioned the persistent losses in GE Vernova Inc.

headlines.title: Is GE Vernova Stock Outperforming the Dow?
headlines.summary: Outpacing the Dow over the past 12 months, GE Vernova continues to receive a highly bullish outlook from Wall Street analysts, reflecting confidence in the company’s long-term prospects.

description: GE Vernova Inc., an energy company, engages in the provision of various products and services that generate, transfer, orchestrate, convert, and store electricity in the United States, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Power, Wind, and Electrification. The Power segment designs, manufactures, and services gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies. It serves industrial, government, and other customers. The Wind segment offers wind generation technologies, including onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades. The Electrification segment provides grid solutions; power conversion; electrification software; and solar and storage solutions technologies required for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
